subject: [RFC PATCH 50/57] selftests/mm: attribute collapses by candidate event alone

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch modifies the selftests/mm module to count collapses of a window by matching candidate events instead of isolate events. The recorded PFNs are no longer needed, so they have been removed from the array. This change is part of a larger series of patches and is intended to improve the accuracy and efficiency of the test.
